extraction: F3D ZIP method93(Zstandard), each extracted member checked against size and CRC32; ASM BinaryFile4 read through ezdxf ACIS SAB parser; planar loop geometry rebuilt as native OCCT lines/circular arcs.
source_reference: base ASM body with 266 faces and 21 planar boundary loops; 16 specimen contours, 4 circular holes, 1 rectangular outline. Other bodies include construction/history geometry and are not exported as fixture solids.
